\caption{State-distribution part of the dataset shift (extension S2): one-step NLL (nats per window, seed means) on the highD test fold (in domain) and on every shifted set, raw and reweighted to the highD occupancy of the state space by importance weights over $6 \times 6 \times 6$ quantile bins of $(s, \Delta v, v)$ (raw / reweighted). A reweighted NLL below the raw one would attribute the gap to the states visited; it is higher in 29 of 32 cells (the exceptions: GP residual on IDM on Waymo; LSTM, constant $\sigma$ on Waymo; LSTM, constant $\sigma$ on OpenACC): the gap is conditional on the state, not a matter of which states are visited. Effective sample size of the reweighted sets: NGSIM I-80 0.2\%, US-101 0.1\%, Waymo 3.7\%, OpenACC 5.9\% of their windows.\label{tab:c26_reweight}}
